about_the_game:
Goblin Vyke is a 2D platfomer that blends stealthy thievery with shop management. You’ll play as the cunning goblin Vyke—by night, a thief who sneaks into dungeons to steal treasure; by day, a shrewd merchant who sells goods at inflated prices to rake in profits. Master the art of stealth, dance with death to steal demonic relics; hire employees, expand your franchise empire, and grow your business. Rise from a penniless goblin to a powerful tycoon of the black market!

Steal by Night

As a small goblin, you're no match in combat—but that’s where your cunning shines. Use skills and traps to slip past enemies, snatch valuable loot, and vanish into the shadows.

Sell by Day

To make real money, you need to master the art of upselling. Hype up your goods and use haggle skills to raise a customer’s "Persuasion". If you succeed, they’ll happily overpay. But be careful—if you overdo it, they'll get pissed and hold their money tight.

From a Broke to a Tycoon

You start off as a broke, debt-ridden goblin. But as your stealing skills sharpen and your shop thrives, powerful factions will begin to notice you. They’ll seek your favor and offer alliances. Even the Demon Lord of the Golden Dungeon will take interest—hoping to make you her new champion!
